PLUGIN_DESCRIPTION: Provide Google/GitHub social login for the admin console.
FIELD_GOOGLE_ENABLED_DESC: Enable signing in to the admin console with Google accounts.
FIELD_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID_DESC: OAuth Client ID from Google Cloud Console.
FIELD_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET_DESC: OAuth Client Secret from Google Cloud Console. Keep it secure.
FIELD_GITHUB_ENABLED_DESC: Enable signing in to the admin console with GitHub accounts.
FIELD_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID_DESC: OAuth Client ID from your GitHub OAuth App settings.
FIELD_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET_DESC: OAuth Client Secret from your GitHub OAuth App settings. Keep it secure.
FIELD_AUTO_PROVISION_ENABLED_DESC: When enabled, users can be created automatically after successful social login.
FIELD_AUTO_ACCEPT_EMAIL_INVITES_DESC: When enabled, pending email invitations can be accepted automatically after login.
